subject: maths
question: A train 315 m long is running at a speed of 54 km/h. What time will it take to cross a pole on its route?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the train (L) = 315 m

Speed of the train (S) = 54 km/h

To cross a pole, time (t) = ?

**Formula used:**

Time, t = Distance / Speed

Where, speed must be converted to m/s

Cal
